info.name: Salesforce UI API
info.description:
The Salesforce UI API provides a comprehensive REST interface for building user interfaces that work with Salesforce metadata and data. It returns layout information, picklist values, list views, record data, and object metadata that Lightning components rely on. Unlike the general REST API, the UI API returns UI-ready data including display labels, field types, formatting hints, and page layout assignments.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support
